name: WERE-LEVY-the-stop-refused-through-the-setter
old: playerEntity.crimeCommitted = CRIMES.Criminal_Conspiracy;   // the levy's own write (WERE-LEVY: the field)
new: setCrimeCommitted(playerEntity, CRIMES.Criminal_Conspiracy);   // the levy's own write (WERE-LEVY: the field)
note: REP1 retired the per-minute levy from world.js and exterior.js; its Conspiracy is the watch's stop's, and it writes the field as the levy did.

name: WERE-LEVY-come-quietly-through-the-setter
old: if (crimeId() === 0) playerEntity.crimeCommitted = CRIMES.Criminal_Conspiracy;   // the levy's own write (WERE-LEVY: the field)
new: if (crimeId() === 0) setCrimeCommitted(playerEntity, CRIMES.Criminal_Conspiracy);   // the levy's own write (WERE-LEVY: the field)
note: The stop's come-quietly door writes the levy's Conspiracy on the field.
